# ClearExam

> AI powered admission tutor for Bangladesh university entrance exams including BUET, MBBS, Dhaka University and IBA.

ClearExam helps students prepare for university admission tests with personalized AI tutoring, mock exams from authentic past papers, a question bank of previous year questions, and a revision bank for spaced review of weak areas.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Pick your admission track and start preparing.
- [Question Bank](/question-bank): Browse authentic previous year questions filtered by institution, year and subject.

## Optional

- [Sign In](/auth): Account access for saved progress.
